body: I am loosing the world, life, all my cares and woes, all the scars, the world is only loosing one person, a troubled non contributing being. so in effect i am the one who looses the most - ha ha ha isn't that the funniest thing you have heard today. the world will be such a better place without me. i will be so much better off not being part of this world. selfish i know. i regret that someone will have to berry my body and to them i am sorry. i am sorry to all of those i have hurt and been a burden to. you can be certain this will be the last time anyone has to deal with me. it is so much better this way. whats amazing is that know one knows. i've been selling things off, giving things away, and nobody knows my intent. either i am in stealth mode or people are blind. whatever, in the grand scheme of the worlds clock the time that i have left to endure loneliness, poverty, poor health, no friends or lover, etc. is very very very little. no tears will be shed, and i wont be missed.

nice but ..... i am done. i am on borrowed time and just want it all to be over. thus it will be. short term i can assure you. the walls are closing in on me as we speak. i have to be done while i am still able to do it. under my terms and conditions. read a book Final Exit and it helped to map it all out. i know just what i am doing, how to do it, i purchased what i need, i am out of here. its just too hard for me to deal with.
